description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Uruk-hai Berserker.
When Uruk-hai Berserker dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Uruk-hai Berserker that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Uruk-hai Berserker token enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Uruk-hai Berserker trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Uruk-hai Berserker token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
